    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Main method, entry point for the client. This starts the application using either the CLI view or the GUI one.
      Parameters:
      args - the arguments given with the execution of the client application. If there's no argument, the application is run using the GUI. To start the application using the CLI, run with "-cli" parameter.
